blocks.prompt: 5 (i) From a deck of 13 cards, find in how many ways these are arranging in a rectangular form? Hint (order is matter) All cards.
blocks.explanation:
13 alag alag cards hain aur saare ke saare 13 jagahon par rakhne hain. Hint keh raha hai ke order ahem hai, yani permutation.
Humein arrangements ginne hain.
Plan: jab saari \(n\) cheezein tarteeb se rakhni hon to jawab \({}^{n}P_{n} = n!\) hota hai, yahan \(13!\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 13 alag cards, sab rakhne hain.
Humein find karna hai: kitne tareeqe.
Tareeqa: \({}^{13}P_{13} = \frac{13!}{0!} = 13!\), kyunke \(0! = 1\).

\(10!\) se \(13!\) tak pahunchein
\[10! = 3628800\]
\[11! = 11 \times 3628800 = 39916800\]
\[12! = 12 \times 39916800 = 479001600\]
Kyun: \(n! = n \times (n-1)!\). Is liye har factorial pichhle factorial ko agle number se multiply karke milta hai; shuru se 13 numbers multiply karne ki zaroorat nahi. \(10! = 3628800\) yaad rakhna faida deta hai.

Aakhri qadam
\[13! = 13 \times 479001600\]
\[= 6227020800\]
Kyun: \(12!\) ko 13 se multiply kiya.

Tasdeeq
\[13 \times 479001600 = 4790016000 + 1437004800\]
\[= 6227020800 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: 13 ko \(10 + 3\) mein tor kar multiply kiya: \(10 \times\) aur \(3 \times\) alag alag, phir jama. Bare numbers mein yeh tareeqa ghalti pakar leta hai.

blocks.prompt: 5 (ii) From a deck of 13 cards, find in how many ways these are arranging in a rectangular form? Hint (order is matter) 8 cards.
blocks.explanation:
Ab 13 cards mein se sirf 8 chun kar tarteeb se rakhne hain.
Humein arrangements ginne hain.
Plan: \({}^{13}P_{8}\), yani 13 se neeche 8 numbers ka product, ya seedha \(\frac{13!}{5!}\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(n = 13\), \(r = 8\).
Humein find karna hai: \({}^{13}P_{8}\).
Tareeqa: \({}^{n}P_{r} = \frac{n!}{(n-r)!}\).

Formula lagayein
\[{}^{13}P_{8} = \dfrac{13!}{(13-8)!} = \dfrac{13!}{5!}\]
Kyun: \(13 - 8 = 5\), is liye neeche \(5!\).

Divide karein
\[= \dfrac{6227020800}{120}\]
\[= 51891840\]
Kyun: \(13!\) humne part (i) mein nikal liya tha, dobara nahi nikalna. \(5! = 120\) se divide kiya. Pehle 10 se divide (622702080), phir 12 se (51891840).

Tasdeeq
\[13 \cdot 12 \cdot 11 \cdot 10 = 17160\]
\[9 \cdot 8 \cdot 7 \cdot 6 = 3024\]
\[17160 \times 3024 = 51891840 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Box method ke 8 factors (13 se 6 tak) do groups mein multiply kiye to wohi jawab aaya.

blocks.prompt: 5 (iii) From a deck of 13 cards, find in how many ways these are arranging in a rectangular form? Hint (order is matter) 10 cards.
blocks.explanation:
Ab 13 mein se 10 cards tarteeb se rakhne hain.
Humein arrangements ginne hain.
Plan: \({}^{13}P_{10} = \frac{13!}{3!}\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(n = 13\), \(r = 10\).
Humein find karna hai: \({}^{13}P_{10}\).
Tareeqa: \({}^{n}P_{r} = \frac{n!}{(n-r)!}\).

Divide karein
\[= \dfrac{6227020800}{6}\]
\[= 1037836800\]
Kyun: \(3! = 6\). Dilchasp baat: jitne kam cards chhortay hain, jawab \(13!\) ke utna qareeb hota hai.

Tasdeeq
\[{}^{13}P_{10} = {}^{13}P_{8} \times 5 \times 4\]
\[= 51891840 \times 20 = 1037836800 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \({}^{13}P_{8}\) mein factors 6 par ruk gaye the; \({}^{13}P_{10}\) mein do factors aur aate hain, 5 aur 4.
Dhyan dein: \({}^{13}P_{10}\) ko \({}^{13}P_{3}\) ke barabar samajhna ghalat hai; permutation mein yeh barabri nahi hoti (combination mein hoti hai).
